Offline image format dependencies

UTIF.js 3.1.0 (MIT), https://github.com/photopea/UTIF.js
pako 1.0.11, https://github.com/nodeca/pako
rawconvert-wasm 0.1.1 (MIT), https://www.npmjs.com/package/rawconvert-wasm/v/0.1.1

raw-offline.js contains the rawconvert-wasm 0.1.1 core, WebAssembly binary,
and worker with a local-file bootstrap that passes the binary directly.
The compiled LibRaw 0.22.1 code is distributed under CDDL 1.0.
The LibRaw source release and license are in this directory.
